description: Curated closed tool registry for agent.local (Module 21) -- the attachable-tools registry that route.tools (#27) reads to build its catalog. Each tool is a conforming Life Orchestrator Module invoked as a child skill via -InputsJson/-ArtifactRoot; entrypoints are repo-relative. This registry IS the agent's entire capability surface; there is deliberately no arbitrary-shell/code-exec tool. Descriptions are one-line and sharp because BOTH the router (which tool to pick) and the arg-generator (how to call it) read them. GPU-bound tools (gen.image, gen.music, image.interpret, speech.stt) bind CUDA/a port; the agent runs one tool per step sequentially, so they never contend. Extend by adding conforming skills.

tools.description: Read, write, edit, or append a UTF-8 text file (exactly one op per call). Use it to create a file, read a file's contents, replace an exact string in a file, or append a line.
tools.args_hint: Always: op (one of read|write|edit|append) and path. write/append also need content. edit needs old_string and new_string. read may take start_line/end_line (1-indexed). Paths may be bare filenames (resolved under working_dir).

tools.description: List and search a directory tree, read-only. Returns file/dir/entry counts and, with a glob pattern, the matching file names. Use it to discover what files exist before acting.
tools.args_hint: Required: path (a directory). Optional: depth (int, default 3), pattern (a name glob such as *.md), include_hidden (bool).

tools.description: Take a screenshot of a monitor, a window, or a screen rectangle and save it as an image file. Use it to grab the screen so another tool can read or analyze it.
tools.args_hint: Optional: target (monitor|window|app|region), monitor (primary|all|<index>), title or app (to pick a window), x/y/width/height (for region), format (png|jpg). No input is needed to capture the primary monitor.

tools.description: Read the text out of an image (OCR): returns the recognized words with pixel positions and lines in reading order. Can OCR an image file OR grab the live screen itself when told to capture -- use it directly for 'what does the text on my screen say'.
tools.args_hint: Provide input (path to an image). To OCR the live screen instead, set capture=true (no input needed). Optional: language.

tools.description: Detect objects in an image (COCO-80 classes) and return each as a class label with a confidence score and a bounding box. Can also detect on the live screen when told to capture.
tools.args_hint: Provide input (path to an image), or set capture=true to detect on the live screen. Optional: classes (only report these labels), score_threshold.

tools.description: Interpret an image with a local vision-language model: caption it, describe it in detail, or answer a question about it. Can also interpret the live screen when told to capture. Use it for open-ended 'what is in this picture / on my screen' questions (not plain text extraction -- that is ocr.layout).
tools.args_hint: Provide input (path to an image) and optionally prompt (a question) and mode (caption|describe|vqa|screen). Set capture=true to interpret the live screen.

tools.description: Transcribe an audio or video file into timestamped text (speech-to-text). Use it to turn a recording into words.
tools.args_hint: Required: input (path to an audio/media file, e.g. a .wav/.mp3/.m4a/.mp4). Optional: language.

tools.description: Convert or normalize an audio/media file to another format, sample rate, channel count, or loudness, producing a new audio file. Use it to change an audio file's format (e.g. m4a -> mp3) or make it whisper-ready.
tools.args_hint: Required: input (path to an audio/media file). Optional: format (wav|mp3|flac|opus|ogg|m4a), sample_rate, channels, loudness (none|peak|ebu).

tools.description: Generate an IMAGE (a picture / drawing / photo) from a text prompt with a local Stable Diffusion model, saved as an image file. Use it for 'make/draw a picture of X'.
tools.args_hint: Required: prompt (what to depict). Optional: negative_prompt, width/height (multiples of 8, 128..1024), steps, seed, format (png|jpg|webp).

tools.description: Compose a short piece of instrumental MUSIC (melodies played on instruments -- NOT plain beeps/tones) from a text prompt, saved as an audio file. Use it for 'write/make a tune / melody / piece of music'.
tools.args_hint: Required: prompt (the style/mood, e.g. 'calm solo piano'). Optional: duration (1..30 seconds), format (wav|mp3|...).

tools.description: Move, copy, or PLACE an existing file into a folder (e.g. onto the Desktop or into Downloads), or make a folder. Use it to put a file a previous step produced where the user asked (e.g. 'place it on my desktop'). NOT for editing text -- that is doc.io.
tools.args_hint: op (copy|move|mkdir). copy/move need source (the existing file's full path -- copy it verbatim from the previous step's observation, e.g. its image=... path) and dest (the target: a known folder name like 'desktop'/'downloads'/'documents'/'pictures', or ~, or a full path; a bare folder keeps the source filename). mkdir needs path.
